generator: section5 final checkpoint, epoch60, eval mode
selection: Three consecutive batches of 12; first three queries for nearest neighbors; no ranking or removal
repeated_control: First generated output of each batch repeated 12 times by the viewer data builder; not an observed model collapse
nearest_search: Exhaustive pixel MSE in [0,1] against all 12000 training images; original floating point generated outputs
limitations: Small galleries do not measure population coverage. Pixel nearest neighbors are a sanity check, not a proof against memorization.
